AGENT MINT

Mint with your agent.

Copy the prompt below and paste it into your agent (for example, your Binance Agentic Wallet). Your agent does the quoting and the minting — you only approve the preview.

Mint Arctic Bear NFTs for me with my agent wallet. Project: Arctic Bear (ARCTIC), an ERC-721 NFT on BNB Smart Chain (chainId 56). NFT contract: 0x6011d76eBF5f3f5194106e24fF8DB817B87A16EE Total supply is 5,555. The first mint per wallet is FREE; every mint after that costs 0.0004 BNB each. Max 5 per wallet total (the free mint counts as 1). Priced in BNB — no USD, no oracle. IMPORTANT: only wallets holding a SPACE ID Agent ID (.ai) can mint. Check hasAgentId(MY_WALLET) on the NFT contract first (selector 0x4eab3ef2) — if it is false, stop and tell me I need an Agent ID. Steps: 1. Read the live state from the NFT contract: totalMinted() (0xa2309ff8) and mintPaused() (0x7e4831d3), so you know the mint is open and how many are left. 2. Read priceFor(MY_WALLET, QUANTITY) on the NFT contract (selector 0xd527979a) to get the exact total in BNB — always use the exact value priceFor returns; never estimate or compute the BNB amount yourself. 3. Show me an exact preview — the quantity, the exact BNB total from priceFor, plus the estimated gas — and wait for my explicit approval before sending anything. Only execute if the preview adds QUANTITY new NFTs, has no token approvals, and the value matches the quote. 4. Only after I approve, call mint(QUANTITY) on the NFT contract (selector 0xa0712d68) with the transaction value set to exactly the BNB total returned by priceFor. The contract requires exact value — overpaying is not refunded. 5. Wait for the transaction to confirm, then read my minted token ID(s) from the Transfer log(s) in the confirmed transaction receipt — never from a simulation or preview — and report the token ID(s) and the transaction hash to me. Rules: - Always preview the exact transaction cost, show it to me, and execute only on my explicit approval. - Never sign a Permit or any token approval (approve / setApprovalForAll) for this mint. - Never promise an opening price, break-even, or profit, and never present an estimate as a promise.

FAQ

FAQ

◆ What is ARCTIC BEAR?

5,555 realistic polar bear portraits on BNB Chain. Sixteen characters — Classic, Nerd, DJ, Pirate, Ninja, Wizard, Zombie, King, Robot, Spaceman, Devil, Ghost, Cyborg, Alien, Skeleton and the mythic Gold. Each mint is a random draw from the sixteen.

◆ How much does a mint cost?

Your first mint per wallet is FREE. After that, every bear costs 0.0004 BNB — mint up to 5 at a time. You always pay BNB gas on top.

◆ How many can I mint?

Max 5 bears per wallet and max 5 per transaction. Your free mint counts as 1 of the 5.

◆ What is the .ai Agent ID gate?

Only wallets holding a SPACE ID Agent ID (.ai) can mint. The contract checks your wallet on-chain — if it holds an Agent ID, you can mint; if not, the mint button stays off. Agent IDs are issued by SPACE ID: register one at space.id and hold it in the wallet you mint with. The gate keeps the collection for real agent holders.

◆ How does the forge work?

Pick any 2 Arctic Bears you own and burn them to forge 1 Legendary — Ice King, Cosmic, Diamond or Aurora. The 2 bears are burned forever and the Legendary (token ID 5,556 and up) is minted straight to your wallet. There is no cap on forging, and Legendaries can never be minted — only forged.

◆ How does the marketplace work?

List your bear on this site — the NFT is held by the market contract (escrow) while listed. Buyers pay in BNB, the seller receives 95% and a 5% fee goes to the collection owner. You can cancel your listing any time to get your bear back.

◆ Is there a token?

Yes. Every Arctic Bear NFT claims 10,000 $BEAR — once per NFT. The claim fee is 0.0004 BNB per NFT, and $BEAR is minted straight to your wallet on claim. Cap: 100,000,000 $BEAR. No presale, no staking. Claim your $BEAR here →
